name: route-planner
description: A full-stack web application built for **Gwinnett County Public Schools (GCPS)** field, facilities, and logistics teams to plan, reorder, and optimize daily multi-stop driving routes across **146 active school and support facility locations**.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "green,cyan" "cd backend && uvicorn main:app --reload" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
